cards.title: Teaching Life Skills Before University
cards.body: Middle-class parents often neglect teaching essential domestic skills like laundry and cooking. Children arrive at university unprepared for independent living, missing crucial know-how their peers also lack.

cards.title: The Importance of Saying 'I Love You'
cards.body: Telling your child directly and often that you love them is the most important gift for their sense of security. This simple act of affirmation is foundational to child development.

cards.title: Why Children Are Not Sponges
cards.body: The popular 'children are sponges' metaphor encourages passive learning and can harm kids' brain development. This mindset undermines active engagement essential for optimal learning and growth.

cards.title: Secure Attachment Protects Gen Z From Loneliness
cards.body: Generation Z reports the highest loneliness rates and increased social media misuse among all generations. Building secure attachments early helps prevent these mental health vulnerabilities.

cards.title: Grandparenting Brings Joy and Complexity
cards.body: Grandparenting offers wonderful moments but also unexpected emotional challenges for three generations. Embracing both the joys and difficulties strengthens family bonds across age groups.

cards.title: Preparing for Parenthood After Divorce
cards.body: Therapists identify common dating mistakes people make after divorce when considering new relationships. Understanding these pitfalls helps divorced parents navigate dating while raising children.

cards.title: Postpartum Psychosis Needs Family-Centered Care
cards.body: Postpartum psychosis profoundly affects not only the parent but also their children's wellbeing. Early-intervention models that include family support can prevent tragic outcomes.

cards.title: IKEA Shopping Reveals Your Parenting Gaps
cards.body: The pre-university shopping trip exposes what domestic wisdom parents have actually taught their children. It's a reckoning moment for many families unprepared for independence.

cards.title: Finding Community in Your Suburban Move
cards.body: Moving to the suburbs with family can feel isolating until you discover local connections and activities. Weekend community spaces often become the unexpected heart of suburban life.

cards.title: Sibling Dynamics Resurface as Parents Age
cards.body: Old family conflicts often reappear when adult siblings must coordinate aging parent care. How families navigate caregiving, conflict, and forgiveness shapes wellbeing across generations.
